biography.plain_text: Domenico Dolce is an Italian fashion designer and co-founder of Dolce & Gabbana. Raised around his father's Sicilian tailoring business, he brought craft discipline and southern Italian imagery to the Milan label he built with Stefano Gabbana. The pair remain its creative leaders, spanning ready-to-wear, haute couture, accessories, beauty and home design.

long_biography.plain_text:
Thread, cloth and fittings shaped Dolce’s earliest education. In Polizzi Generosa, he watched his tailor father work for clients across Sicilian society and learned made-to-measure technique before moving to Milan. A design consultancy with Stefano Gabbana evolved into a women’s collection in 1985, followed by menswear, fragrance and a wider luxury house.

Dolce’s role has always combined cutting-room precision with cultural memory. Sicilian black, lace, religious iconography and Mediterranean femininity became recurring codes, while the privately held group expanded into jewellery, watches, interiors and beauty. He and Gabbana still direct the brand’s creative language and growth strategy, pairing couture craft with an international retail business.
